context: Hiroshi-boss attends a local concert with his old friend Goro-grandpa.
purpose: Two older men admiring music together; nostalgic camaraderie.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Warm appreciation settles in slowly. Gentle, measured cadence — no rush. Eyes calm and distant, remembering. Small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: ええ、本当に感動しました。
lines.style: Sincere and steady. A moment of pause before speaking — genuine emotion without performance. Soft conviction. The voice of someone who doesn't overstate.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: 若い人の音楽、新鮮やわ。
lines.en: Young people's music these days — so fresh.
lines.style: Reflective, almost musing. Slight warmth at 「新鮮」. Not nostalgic, but noticing the difference with affection. Conversational, like thinking aloud with a friend.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 拍手が、長く続きましたね。
lines.en: The applause really did go on quite a while.
lines.style: Quiet observation, gentle pleasure in the detail. Pacing is unhurried. Eyes bright with the small satisfaction of noticing what matters.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.jp: お客さんも、満足してた。
lines.style: Calm confirmation, almost to himself. Observant tone — he's reading the room accurately. Small warmth on 「満足」. At peace with what he's seen.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 次回も、一緒に来ましょう。
lines.en: Let's come together next time as well.
lines.style: Gentle invitation, not presumptuous. Warm on the suggestion. Opening is steady, trailing with quiet ease — the comfort of assuming good company without needing to ask.

lines.speaker: goro_grandpa
lines.style: Small, genuine laugh on the opening. Quiet contentment. Slow exhale. The voice of someone at ease, agreeing to something already settled between them.
